checks.name: chat_purchase_drafts_submission_check
checks.expression: ((status = 'submitted'::text) AND (order_id IS NOT NULL) AND (submitted_version IS NOT NULL) AND (submitted_version > 0)) OR ((status <> 'submitted'::text) AND (order_id IS NULL) AND (submitted_version IS NULL))
checks.definition: CHECK (((((status)::text = 'submitted'::text) AND (order_id IS NOT NULL) AND (submitted_version IS NOT NULL) AND (submitted_version > 0)) OR (((status)::text <> 'submitted'::text) AND (order_id IS NULL) AND (submitted_version IS NULL))))

checks.name: orders_amount_check
checks.expression: (currency = 'CNY'::text) AND (payment_mode = 'simulated'::text) AND (items_amount >= 0) AND (shipping_amount = 0) AND (discount_amount = 0) AND (payable_amount = items_amount)
checks.definition: CHECK ((((currency)::text = 'CNY'::text) AND ((payment_mode)::text = 'simulated'::text) AND (items_amount >= (0)::numeric) AND (shipping_amount = (0)::numeric) AND (discount_amount = (0)::numeric) AND (payable_amount = items_amount)))

checks.name: orders_close_state_check
checks.expression: ((status = 'closed'::text) AND (close_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (close_reason = ANY (ARRAY['user_cancelled'::character varying, 'payment_expired'::character varying, 'product_unavailable'::character varying])) AND (closed_at IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status <> 'closed'::text) AND (close_reason IS NULL) AND (closed_at IS NULL))
checks.definition: CHECK (((((status)::text = 'closed'::text) AND (close_reason IS NOT NULL) AND ((close_reason)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['user_cancelled'::character varying, 'payment_expired'::character varying, 'product_unavailable'::character varying])::text[])) AND (closed_at IS NOT NULL)) OR (((status)::text <> 'closed'::text) AND (close_reason IS NULL) AND (closed_at IS NULL))))

checks.name: orders_completed_state_check
checks.expression: ((status = 'completed'::text) AND (completed_at IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status <> 'completed'::text) AND (completed_at IS NULL))
checks.definition: CHECK (((((status)::text = 'completed'::text) AND (completed_at IS NOT NULL)) OR (((status)::text <> 'completed'::text) AND (completed_at IS NULL))))

checks.name: orders_payment_state_check
checks.expression: ((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending_payment'::character varying, 'closed'::character varying])) AND (paid_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending_shipment'::character varying, 'pending_receipt'::character varying, 'completed'::character varying])) AND (paid_at IS NOT NULL))
checks.definition: CHECK (((((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['pending_payment'::character varying, 'closed'::character varying])::text[])) AND (paid_at IS NULL)) OR (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['pending_shipment'::character varying, 'pending_receipt'::character varying, 'completed'::character varying])::text[])) AND (paid_at IS NOT NULL))))

checks.name: orders_shipment_state_check
checks.expression: ((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending_payment'::character varying, 'pending_shipment'::character varying, 'closed'::character varying])) AND (shipped_at IS NULL) AND (shipment_carrier IS NULL) AND (shipment_tracking_no IS NULL)) OR ((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending_receipt'::character varying, 'completed'::character varying])) AND (shipped_at IS NOT NULL) AND (shipment_carrier IS NOT NULL) AND (shipment_tracking_no IS NOT NULL))
checks.definition: CHECK (((((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['pending_payment'::character varying, 'pending_shipment'::character varying, 'closed'::character varying])::text[])) AND (shipped_at IS NULL) AND (shipment_carrier IS NULL) AND (shipment_tracking_no IS NULL)) OR (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['pending_receipt'::character varying, 'completed'::character varying])::text[])) AND (shipped_at IS NOT NULL) AND (shipment_carrier IS NOT NULL) AND (shipment_tracking_no IS NOT NULL))))

checks.name: return_refund_applications_manual_review_check
checks.expression: (manual_review_required AND (manual_review_reason = ANY (ARRAY['order_not_completed'::character varying, 'completion_time_missing'::character varying, 'outside_return_window'::character varying]))) OR ((NOT manual_review_required) AND (manual_review_reason IS NULL))
checks.definition: CHECK (((manual_review_required AND ((manual_review_reason)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['order_not_completed'::character varying, 'completion_time_missing'::character varying, 'outside_return_window'::character varying])::text[]))) OR ((NOT manual_review_required) AND (manual_review_reason IS NULL))))

checks.name: return_refund_applications_rejection_check
checks.expression: ((status = 'rejected'::text) AND (rejection_reason IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status <> 'rejected'::text) AND (rejection_reason IS NULL))
checks.definition: CHECK (((((status)::text = 'rejected'::text) AND (rejection_reason IS NOT NULL)) OR (((status)::text <> 'rejected'::text) AND (rejection_reason IS NULL))))

checks.name: return_refund_applications_return_shipment_check
checks.expression: ((status = ANY (ARRAY['returned_by_user'::character varying, 'pending_inspection'::character varying, 'refund_processing'::character varying, 'refunded'::character varying])) AND (return_carrier IS NOT NULL) AND (return_tracking_no IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status <> ALL (ARRAY['returned_by_user'::character varying, 'pending_inspection'::character varying, 'refund_processing'::character varying, 'refunded'::character varying])) AND (return_carrier IS NULL) AND (return_tracking_no IS NULL))
checks.definition: CHECK (((((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['returned_by_user'::character varying, 'pending_inspection'::character varying, 'refund_processing'::character varying, 'refunded'::character varying])::text[])) AND (return_carrier IS NOT NULL) AND (return_tracking_no IS NOT NULL)) OR (((status)::text <> ALL ((ARRAY['returned_by_user'::character varying, 'pending_inspection'::character varying, 'refund_processing'::character varying, 'refunded'::character varying])::text[])) AND (return_carrier IS NULL) AND (return_tracking_no IS NULL))))

checks.name: return_refund_evidence_size_check
checks.definition: CHECK (((((media_type)::text = 'video/mp4'::text) AND ((byte_size >= 16) AND (byte_size <= 52428800))) OR (((media_type)::text <> 'video/mp4'::text) AND ((byte_size >= 1) AND (byte_size <= 10485760)))))

checks.name: user_preferences_source_required_check
checks.expression: (source_conversation_id IS NULL) OR (source_status IS NOT NULL)
checks.definition: CHECK (((source_conversation_id IS NULL) OR (source_status IS NOT NULL)))

views.name: active_order_sku_reservations
views.definition:
SELECT item.sku_id,
    sum(item.quantity) AS reserved_quantity
   FROM (order_items item
     JOIN orders order_record ON ((order_record.id = item.order_id)))
  WHERE ((order_record.status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['pending_payment'::character varying, 'pending_shipment'::character varying])::text[]))
  GROUP BY item.sku_id
